parts.script:
Sarah: Hey Tom, have you thought about what we should do this weekend? I heard there’s a great hiking trail at Silver Lake. 

Tom: That sounds fun! How long is the trail? 

Sarah: I think it’s about five miles long, and it’s supposed to have some amazing views. 

Tom: Perfect! Should we pack a picnic as well? 

Sarah: Absolutely! We could bring sandwiches and some snacks. What do you think? 

Tom: Sounds good to me. What time do you want to leave? 

Sarah: I’d say we should get an early start. Maybe around 7 AM? 

Tom: That works! Should we invite Jake and Lisa too? 

Sarah: Yes, let’s do that! I’ll text them right now. 

Tom: Great! I can take care of the drinks if you handle the food. 

Sarah: Deal! I’ll bring a cooler to keep it all fresh. 

Tom: Awesome! Looking forward to some fresh air this weekend. 

Sarah: Me too! It’ll be a nice break from all this studying.

questions.question: What is the main activity Sarah and Tom are planning for the weekend?
questions.explanation: The conversation revolves around planning a hiking trip.

questions.question: Complete the form. Write no more than TWO WORDS.
questions.explanation: The destination for the trip is Silver Lake and they plan to leave at 7 AM.

questions.question: What will Tom bring for the trip?
questions.explanation: Tom mentions that he will take care of the drinks for their picnic.
